name: Customized Home
description: Customized Home lets every user reorganize the Jellyfin home screen: reorder sections by drag and drop, hide or show them, and group them into collapsible folders (for example a "Series" folder holding every series related section). Works with the built-in sections and with sections added by other plugins (Home Screen Sections, Jellyfin Enhanced, ...). Requires the File Transformation plugin to inject the client script.
overview: Reorder, hide and group the home screen sections into folders.
